description: Mono frames of long windows with a TNS filter of order 13, 20 and 31 over 30 bands: the standard limits the order to 12 and decodes the first 12 coefficients; the field allows more, so the stream is reported.
findings: a TNS filter of a higher order than the 12 its window allows

skip.decode: ffmpeg refuses a TNS filter of an order above 12 ("TNS filter order ... is greater than maximum").
skip.faad_trace: faad2 does not trace the filter's order.
